production_concerns.where: pte-api/app/src/main/java/com/pte/identity/internal/repository/UserRepository.java:139-142 (countByRoleGroupedByTenant), called by IdentityOverviewService.studentCountsByTenant (once per uncached dashboard build)
production_concerns.finding: Must read every student row; Seq Scan users + Seq Scan user_roles, Hash Join, Sort with external-merge spill (count(distinct u.id) forces the sort), ~95 ms at 100k students. Linear growth: ~1 s at ~1M students, near the 2 s timeout hint (the 60 s section cache and the hint bound the damage).
production_concerns.suggested_fix: Use count(u.id) / count(*) instead of count(distinct u.id): user_roles is unique per (user_id, role) so the count is exact and the plan becomes a plain HashAggregate (~45 ms, no sort, no spill). If the table grows: user_roles(role, user_id) and users(tenant_id, id) WHERE deleted = false for index-only scans.

production_concerns.finding: Status-less created_at / redeemed_at range counts are sequential scans (1.7-4.5 ms at 12-30k rows) because the V96 indexes lead with status. Fine at current volumes.
production_concerns.suggested_fix: If these tables pass ~1M rows add created_at-only partial indexes (WHERE deleted = false) and license_codes(redeemed_at).

observations: No production bug found in Phase 3 code; every success criterion was met. Role gating, per-section cache, bucket isolation, Memo sharing and the JSON round trip of all 8 cached payload types (production Spring Boot mapper included) all behave as designed.

Real PlatformOperationPolicy outcome (derived, not assumed): PLATFORM_MANAGER sees all 8 Phase 3 sections exactly like PLATFORM_ADMIN and shares its cache bucket; ACADEMIC_MANAGER, ACADEMIC_STAFF and legacy PLATFORM_AUTHOR see none (bucket 'none', HTTP 200, all FORBIDDEN). Because the policy is all-or-nothing today, the partial-visibility bucket paths (e.g. 'learners+tenants') are only exercised through the key builder, not through a role.

Standalone MockMvc has no filter chain, so an anonymous request is stopped only by the method-security proxy (the handler maps it to a 5xx there); the real 401 is the chain's anyRequest().authenticated(), proven by SecurityConfigDashboardPathTest (neither dashboard path is public).

learners.totalStudents counts students of non-deleted tenants only (joined with seat limits) while activeLearners counts distinct students platform-wide including those of deleted tenants; both are by design of the implemented query shape.
idx_attempts_submitted (V96) has no production caller yet (kept for later admin sections); EXPLAIN shows it works for the platform-wide submitted count.
Mockito prints the 'dynamic agent' warning in this JDK; Hibernate/H2 print DDL warnings for unrelated entities; both pre-existing and unrelated.

phase1_test_edits_review.OverviewMigrationPostgresIntegrationTest: The Phase 1 host-query EXPLAIN seed held only two tenants (tenant A = 50 percent of every table). After V96 added the narrow time-only indexes, the planner (correctly for that skew) chose idx_attempts_started/submitted instead of the tenant-leading indexes for the TENANT-scoped host queries, so the Phase 1 assertion 'forced plan contains idx_attempts_tenant_*' failed. The seed now uses 20 interleaved tenants (tenant A = 5 percent, same total row counts; sessions keep their original two-tenant shape) which restores a production-like selectivity. Every assertion is unchanged; the test is more realistic, not weaker. Evidence of the interplay is in tests/phase-03-explain-plans.txt.
Renamed from ...ThroughV95 to ...ThroughV96 and strengthened (>= 96 migrations, versions contain 94, 95 and 96).
phase1_test_edits_review.EXPLAIN output: explain() now uses `summary on` so the report shows planning/execution times; the verdict extraction is unaffected.
